{{Otheruses|Rat}}
A '''meer rat''' was a rotund rodent that could be found dwelling in the buildings of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and other heavily populated [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. They were also found on [[Dontamo]].
